Unit circle, unwrapped — sin, cos & tan from one rotating point

A point rotates on the circle. Its height is sin θ, its horizontal reach is cos θ — and the ray through it meets the vertical tangent line at tan θ. Watch all three trace their graphs beside the circle; drag the dot or scrub the graphs. Prefer the classic unwrap-around-a-box? Toggle 3D.
